content: JESUS EḎUA HIBAIṮOM
Jesus Nug moḏp̱a niieye amu Juda dilag Meṯid male, Maria, Magdala ted amu Jakobus anig Maria amu Salome ele ag keeke muṯuḏig enanag ele Jesus gaḏa bap̱aidḵulagnu daden mep̱ig.
Aria Juda dilag Meṯid male uḵe, wagḏe buṯuanab aam dig ma beebe amu ag ahan, men moḏp̱a, Jesus gaḏa bap̱aidḵulagnu gonana,
ag aḵa aḵa ap̱ig. “Aun nug ehaniḵa, men naḏi moḏ oḏep̱an amu, men amu duṯuna megaḵu?” Men amuam naḏinab amunu ag anam ap̱ig.
Ag anam maṯinna, ag neeḵeg uḵe, men naḏi moḏ oḏep̱anu amu laa nug duṯune uḵom.
Amunu ag gona, men moḏ oop̱a nona, nid bau laa nug lamen haḵab ele nug naḏiapp̱a dayeye anidna, ag baḏap̱ig.

Ag anam baḏan heegeg amu nid bau amu nug aum. “Ag aib baḏap̱ig. Ag Nasaret ted Jesus, ad emaitakp̱a atulp̱ig ele madiṯeb amge Nug ip̱a ii daaṯe. Nug eḏua hibaiṯom. Ag Nug mep̱ig aben amu iiḵude anṯeg!
Amunu ag gona, Petrus amu Jesusnu ip̱uniṯak awak danab laa oh ele inam ap̱eg dooglag. ‘Jesus Nug anuqa, Galelia goṯe amunu ag ele gona, Nug anuḵa aum bia ap̱a Nug anidḵulag,’” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu ah ag eḏun, dimiṯim gona, moḏ uuna, ag beḏulag hahaḏeḏe, dab mak kuḏum aop̱ig. Ag huan baḏap̱ig amunu ag danab laa amegp̱a ii ap̱ig.
[Jesus Nug Meṯidp̱a, wagḏe buṯuanab eḏua hibaiṯowa amu Nug tatam Maria, Magdala ted, nug gumiṯa waum. Ah amuam Jesus Nug anuḵa ouḏi nau eblaih aḏit ele beḏup̱anu lamaṯom.
Ah nug Jesus anṯa amu nug uḵa, nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab, ag oolag ug ele gaana daaegeg, ag amelagp̱a inam aum. “Jesus Nug eḏua hibaiṯa, bau daaṯe! Da Nug anidmi,” awa aum.
Nug anam a, ag Jesus eḏua hibaiṯom, ah amu Nug ele anṯom doop̱ig amge ag oolagp̱a genab ii doop̱ig.
Aria dimp̱a danab aḏit laa a laih goḵulahnu ibp̱a uḵaeheh, Jesus Nug beḏu eḏua gumata waum.
Wana amu Jesus Nug he, a Nug dooiya, a eḏuya goya, nai amu aeh amu laa ag oolagp̱a genab ii doop̱ig.

Danab laala ag, “Jesus eḏua aha, bau daaṯe,” aeg, ip̱uniṯak awak danab elewen ag doop̱ig amge ag oolagp̱a genab ii doop̱ig. Ag nai amunu ahilag dab makib dim lamidna, “Elele iiṯa,” ap̱ig amunu dimp̱a Jesus Nug ag e lanana daaegeg, Nug tula gumaṯa wana, Nug ahilag hak aḏit amunu alaṯom.
Alaṯowa amu Nug ag amelagp̱a aum. “Ag ahan, wan atu ohp̱a gona, dahilnu Nai Ena danab oh amelagp̱a aig!
Ag ap̱eg doona amu danab laa nug oop̱a genab doya, layaṯak aweb amu Kayak nug eḏua aoḵu. Laa nug oop̱a genab ii doya amu nug Kayak noobp̱a nai ele daaḵu.
Danab ag dahilnu oolagp̱a genab dooṯeb ele amu, ag da onilp̱a kobol laala danab heḵunu elele iiṯa imubia heḵulag. Ag ouḏi nau lamadḵulag, ag nailag piḏe piḏe maṯiglag.
Ag mat nau aḏaglag o le eheḏ laa laḵulag amu amup̱a ag ii mauhmana. Ag oḏe danab beḏulag aḏap̱eg, ag oḏe uuadḵu,” awa aum.
Jesus Nug anam a amu Kayak Nug he, Jesus Nug hab aṯan ta, Kayak ep̱eg naḏiapp̱a, amuam anuqak aben, amup̱a heḏep na daaṯe.
Aria ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag wan ohp̱a gona, Jesusnu nai mehuqegeg, Jesus Nug ag ehanaṯeṯe, ag uḏat naḏi g̱agaṯag laala ele heegeg, amup̱a danab ag mehuqak ahilag genab doop̱ig.]
